description: Land Acquisition - Marangahawela, Haldummulla D/S Division, Badulla District. (Section 07)
categorisation: This gazette notice is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the compulsory acquisition of a specific parcel of land (0.0996 hectares) for a public purpose (landslide control structures). It contains detailed descriptions of the land's location, boundaries, and current use, and serves as a legal notice to interested parties regarding the acquisition process and compensation claims. The content is exclusively focused on land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of a Land Gazette.
